newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Death toll rises to 22 in Siberian vodka poisoning.
newsitem.headline: Death toll rises to 22 in Siberian vodka poisoning.

text.p: Several more people have died in the Siberian city of Krasnoyarsk after drinking tainted vodka, bringing the death toll to 22 since Thursday, Itar-Tass news agency quoted the local prosecutor's office as saying on Monday.

The number of deaths could rise further. A further 12 people are in intensive care and officials said they did not know the condition of several others who had left on weekend trips to the country after drinking the brew poisoned with methylated spirit.
On Sunday, police said 18 people had died over three days out of 31 believed at the time to have sampled the drink.
Several of those who distributed it have been arrested.
The number of alcohol-related deaths in Russia has more than doubled during the 1990s as many vendors have offered cheap moonshine dressed up in fancy bottles to a public eager for bargains.
